digest.component_or_area: edit and claim CLI commands with embedded plan-review verification
propositions: The edit-then-review workflow requires two separate shell commands and is error-prone; a --review flag on edit should embed review as a post-commit operation.
The claim command's recovery text directs users to manually run review-plan then claim; a --review flag on claim should embed verification and gate checking before attempting to claim.
The --review flag must parse as valueless (not consuming the following token) and be handled before the field loop in the parser.

claim --review must apply a two-stage gate check: call llm.claim_gate_check first, then review_plan only if not-ok, and proceed to claim only on PASS verdict; on BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, or retryable degrade, the claim core must not run.
Both flags must map review verdicts to ADR-0040 disposition exit codes (0 PASS, 1 BLOCK, 2 INDETERMINATE, 11 retryable) and not hold the store lock across the multi-minute LLM review pass.
